title: Better Loot Zibura
description: Improve vanilla structure loot. Compatible with Ctov, Kaleidoscope Cookery, Farmers delight, Farm and Charm, and more
body:
# **NOTE: (0.5.0)**  Please ensure you have KubeLoader, LootJS, Kubejs, Polymorph, and Rhino installed. In 1.20.1 you also have to download Architectury API. If something went wrong, try /reload first. # **How it works:** This mod **_does not_ add any new items** on its own. Instead, it distributes vanilla and mod items into the loot chests where they naturally belong. You do **not** need to install every compatible mod, as the mod will only handle existing items. For example, if you only have _Farmer's Delight_ installed, items from _Farm & Charm_ will simply be ignored and won't appear.  # **Structure Compatibility:** **Village and Pillage Support:** _Towns and Towers,  Luki's Grand Capitals, Katters Structures, Explorify, Trek, Dungeons and Taverns, CTOV (ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages)_ # 1. village house   ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1789/300/village-png.png) **And other biomes:**  **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1789/301/village-other-biome-png.png)** **_Mod items displayed above require their corresponding mods to be installed._** Each chest of village house now contains **4 categories: crops, wealth & tools, dishes, and drinks**.  There is a low probability that some village house chests will actually contain **Carpenter** or **Baker** loot. ### **Supported Villages in these Structure Mods:** *  _Towns and Towers, Luki's Grand Capitals, Katters Structures, Explorify, Trek, Dungeons and Taverns, CTOV_ * _Other structures in these structure mods are not supported yet._ ### **Supported Food Mods:** *  **Installing these mods will give you the most majority of the full experience of food:** _Kaleidoscope Cookery_, _Farmer's Delight_, _Crate Delight_, _Let's do_ _Bakery_, _Fruits delight_ * **And these mods are also supported:** _Barbecue's Delight_, _Berry Good_, _Brewery_, _Brewin' and Chewin'_,  _Dumplings Delight_, _Farm & Charm_, _Kaleidoscope Chinese Food_, _Kaleidoscope Nether_, _KitchenKarrot_, _More Delight_, _Rationcraft_, _Rustic Delight_, _Vanilla Cookbook_, _Youkai's Feasts / Youkai's Homecoming, Muffins Thai Delight, Vintage Delight, Pineapple delight_ **_If you launch minecraft without any of mods listed above, the plains village chest may look like this:_** _![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1743/857/village-plain-without-mod-png.png)_   # 2. village professions   ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1789/302/prefession-png.png) **_Mod items displayed above require their corresponding mods to be installed._** Loots in houses of the **butcher, baker, carpenter, mason, shepherd and leatherworker** now changes based on the **biome**. For instance, a Mason’s chest in a Desert village will now contain sandstone and smooth stone blocks, while their counterpart in the Badlands yields terracotta and glazed terracotta variants.  * _**Butcher:**_ meat,meat product, and knives. * _**Baker:**_ bread, dessert, and baking material. * _**Carpenter:**_ furniture, wooden functional blocks, materials of wood, saplings, and tools.  * **_Mason:_** material and product, functional or decorative. * **_Shepherd:_** dyes, wools, wool product, and shears. * _**Tannery:**_ leather and leather products. ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1789/303/profession2-png.png) Other village professions loot have been modified as well, but they only have a single loot set that remains the same everywhere. * _**Blacksmith:**_ metal ingot, medal product, including iron, gold, copper, diamond. * _**Cartographer:**_ paper, maps, cartography tools, ink and markers, and room decorations. * _**Cleric:**_ books, potions, brewing materials, gems, and baubles. * _**Fisher:**_ fishes, fish products, fishing rods, and knives. ### **Supported Mods:** * _Supplementaries, Explorer's Compass, Nature's Compass, Sawmill, Stone Chests, Stoneworks, Traveler's Backpack, Wooden Shears, Kaleidoscope (Cookery / Chinesefood / Tavern), Farmer's Delight, More Delight, Let's do Bakery, Let's do Brewery, Farm & Charm, Vintage Delight, Rationcraft, Youkai's Feasts, Youkai's Homecoming, Touhou Little Maid, Trail & Tales Delight, LolMCV._ # 3. Treasure Chests   **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1760/995/minecraft-png.png)** * _**General:**_ * **Iron ingots** in treasure chests have been **deleted**. There are **more diamonds** instead.  * **Undying totems** have become more common. * _**Abandoned mineshaft:**_ raw ores, tools, enchanted books, pottery sherds, and lights. * **_Buried treasure:_** emeralds & emerald blocks, smithing template coast & tide, gold or diomond products, and valuable ocean stuff. * **Desert pyramid:** treasure (diamonds, emeralds, pearls), smithing template dune, golden foods/potions, gold & diamond gear (swords, armor, horse armor), and anvils. * **_Jungle temple:_** gold, treasure, smithing template wild, enchanted books. * _**Pillager outpost:**_ weapons, meat, canned food, enchanted books. * _**Ruined portal:**_ gold armor, netherrack, blocks from nether (with a low chance of ancient debris). * _**Shipwreck supply:**_ crop and fish. * **_Shipwreck treasure:_** ancient crops, valuable things, any kind of pottery sherd, music disc, smithing template (overworld type only). * _**Simple dungeon:**_ mob drops, any kind of music disc and smithing template (overworld type only), lights, treasure, enchanted armors and weapons. * _**Woodland Mansion:**_ loot chest is randomly assigned one of six themes: * **Weapons:** iron axes, iron swords, and crossbows. * **Treasures:** diamond product, ingot and blocks. * **Music:** note blocks or jukebox, any kind of music disc (overworld type only), * **Wool & Dyes:** dyes and colored wool products. * **Cuisine:** big meals and alcohol. * **Food Supply:** crops. ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1760/996/woodland-mansion-png.png) ### **You may get special items from these supported Mods:**
  • Supplementaries, Immersive Armors, Immersive Enchanting, My Nether's Delight, Touhou Little Maid, Youkais Feasts.
 
 
# Additional Notes 1. This mod clears out the original vanilla Minecraft loot tables, so some datapacks may not work. 2. Removed the cakes and cameras added to various structures by the _Touhou Little Maid_  mod to maintain overall immersion. 3. The Nether, the End, Ancient City and Trial Chambers **have not been modified yet**. 4. **Paired Spawns:** Whenever a crop crate or sack appears in a loot chest, its corresponding single crop will spawn too. (1.21.1 only) 5. When multiple mods introduce the same crop (like tomatoes), the mod **prioritizes them in this order**: Kaleidoscope Cookery → Farmer's Delight → Farm & Charm → Other Mods. If you prefer the Farmer's Delight version (or any other variant), you can easily **swap them** directly in your **inventory crafting grid.**
